newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-TNT shares open 50 pct up after bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-TNT shares open 50 pct up after bid.

text.p: Transport group TNT Ltd's shares opened 81 cents or 50 percent higher at A$2.44 on Wednesday after Dutch telecoms and postal group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) bid A$2.45 per share cash for TNT.

TNT said it would recommend the bid, which values TNT at A$2.0 billion. "I would have thought that's a sensational deal and shareholders won't be able to get out quick enough," James Capel director of institutional sales Stephen Streeter said.
"It'll get through. I can't see it being over-bid," he said.
"It stands to reason it would (be accepted)," said Kevin Massey, institutional dealer at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett.
"It's fairly dramatic. They're certainly not penny pinching," Massey said.
"You could get someone else coming in over the top like Fedex (Federal Express Corp ), but we think it's unlikely," he said.
